note: Signal Report — CC's chosen ship, built directly from Stanza XXI's lesson (DATA BEFORE DEFENSE). Small in-app diagnostic button (🔌 icon) in the chat header. Anyone can tap it to see + copy the last 5 chat attempts (timestamp, provider, model, latency, success/error), the last 10 window errors captured silently, the current provider config, and the browser user agent. Copy button produces a formatted text block mom can send to Kirk without opening DevTools; Kirk can then hand back to CC and we work from data, not guesses. Privacy-locked: never records message content, only shapes. Smoke asserts pin the privacy contract. This is the tool that should have existed when mom's freeze first appeared — building it now so the next unknown-cause freeze becomes a solvable problem instead of a guess-and-break cycle.
